workItem: Temporarily supersede AAL2 requirements in normal login and registration authentication, preserve enrolled MFA factors and privileged server AAL2 authorization, add nonblocking diagnostic logging, then support staged reactivation.
workItemDE: AAL2 für normalen Login und Registrierung temporär superseden, Faktoren erhalten, privilegiertes Server-AAL2 unverändert lassen und stufenweise Diagnose ermöglichen
projectStage: cross-cutting security diagnostic; no productive PVC ownership transfer
priorityReason: Productive Google login experiences a roughly 10-second apparent stall before the native AAL2 gate; isolation requires removing AAL2 from the user-authentication critical path without deleting factors or weakening privileged authorization.
scopeBoundary: All public.profiles rows are read back with mfa_required_account=false; no factor is deleted or mutated.
Stage 0 removes AAL2 only from normal login and registration authentication.
Primary Supabase identity verification, OAuth, bearer validation, IAM role checks and subscription authority are unchanged.
src/platform/Security/authMiddleware.ts and privileged requireVerifiedAal2()/requireStepUp() semantics remain identical to CURRENT_MAIN.
No email-address or hard-coded user-ID bypass is introduced.
Stage changes require ordinary branch/PR/required-check/Human-CODEOWNER convergence.
No Stripe, Render, secrets, DNS, billing, factor deletion or schema mutation is included.

evidence.supabaseBeforeAfter: 5 profiles total; 0 with mfa_required_account=true; 5 with false; update-to-false returned no rows; 3 profiles retain verified native MFA factors.
evidence.priorPr: #1256 closed unmerged as superseded after Owner expanded diagnostic scope.
evidence.securityBoundary: Privileged authMiddleware AAL2 implementation restored byte-for-byte from CURRENT_MAIN before PR creation.
evidence.overlap: No open PR writer matched AAL2/MFA/session-composition scope at latest correlation.

acceptanceCriteria: Stage 0 is explicit in one runtime module and disables login/registration AAL2 requirements.
Normal Google login does not execute native factor/challenge choreography when Stage 0 is active.
Registration still requires profile/consent completion but skips MFA enrollment at Stage 0 and persists mfa_required_account=false.
Existing verified native factors remain present and unchanged.
A nonblocking authenticated server diagnostic checkpoint records stage/account policy for login correlation.
Privileged server requireVerifiedAal2()/requireStepUp() remains strict and unchanged from CURRENT_MAIN.
Enterprise tier remains server-authoritative and no provisional Free state is reintroduced.
Focused and full required tests pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
releaseReason: Human/CODEOWNER merged PR #1257 into main@8cf32de51821a48f58a7bd86b2d6e0222a0f9cde; fresh Owner direction supersedes the diagnostic client-auth path with a backend-first authentication rebuild.
